name: Brilliant Blue FCF
aliases: E133, INS 133, brilliant blue FCF, brilliant blue, FD&C Blue No. 1, FD&C Blue 1, Blue 1, Acid Blue 9
what_is: A synthetic certified food colour known as Brilliant Blue FCF and declared under different names or numbering systems depending on the market.
why_botia: BOTIA flags Brilliant Blue FCF because very little of it is absorbed from the intestine, so most passes through the body without entering the bloodstream. JECFA established an acceptable daily intake and concluded that estimated dietary exposure does not present a health concern. In the United States, many food companies and industry groups have committed to removing petroleum-based synthetic food dyes from their products. This is a voluntary industry transition, not a ban.
